title: Ceph cluster
description: PVE Ceph cluster lylat: health, capacity and forecast, client I/O, PGs and recovery, OSDs, slow ops/BlueStore, monitors and managers, CephFS, RBD images and OSD hosts.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Overall cluster health (ceph health). The checks behind a WARN/ERR are listed next to it.

panels.title: Active health checks
panels.description: Health checks currently raised (ceph health detail): orange = HEALTH_WARN, red = HEALTH_ERR. BLUESTORE_SLOW_OP_ALERT means OSDs saw BlueStore operations slower than bluestore_slow_ops_warn_threshold; see Slow ops and BlueStore below.

panels.title: Health history
panels.description: Cluster health and every check the active mgr has seen since it started (green = clear).

panels.title: Raw capacity used
panels.description: Raw used / raw total over all OSDs (replication included). Ceph warns per OSD at nearfull (85%) and stops writes at full (95%); see Fullest OSD.

panels.title: OSDs
panels.description: OSDs up and in, of all OSDs in the OSD map.

panels.title: OSDs down / out
panels.description: OSDs that are down or marked out.

panels.title: Monitors
panels.description: Monitors in quorum / monitors in the monmap.

panels.title: Managers
panels.description: The active mgr (serves the metrics) and the number of standbys.

panels.title: MDS
panels.description: Active MDS for CephFS (rank ≥ 0) and standbys.

panels.title: PGs
panels.description: Placement groups, and how many aren't active+clean (recovering, degraded, peering, …).

panels.title: Read IOPS
panels.description: Client read operations per second, all pools.

panels.title: Write IOPS
panels.description: Client write operations per second, all pools.

panels.title: Read latency
panels.description: Average OSD client read latency (queue + processing) over all OSDs.

panels.title: Write latency
panels.description: Average OSD client write latency over all OSDs. HDD OSDs without a flash DB/WAL usually sit in the tens of ms.

panels.title: Recovery
panels.description: Recovery and backfill traffic between OSDs.

panels.title: Objects at risk
panels.description: Object copies degraded (missing replicas) + misplaced (waiting to move) + unfound. The breakdown is under Placement groups and recovery.

panels.title: Raw capacity
panels.description: Raw bytes over all OSDs. Pools are 3× replicated, so usable space is about a third.

panels.title: Pool usage
panels.description: Stored / (stored + max available) per pool. Max available is what the fullest OSD in the pool's CRUSH rule still allows, so all pools share it.

panels.title: Data stored per pool
panels.description: Logical data per pool, before replication.

panels.title: Fullest OSD
panels.description: The most-used OSD. Ceph raises OSD_NEARFULL at 85% and blocks writes at 95%, whatever the cluster average.

panels.title: Fullest OSD nearfull in
panels.description: Linear forecast from the last 7 days of the fullest OSD's growth. Empty when it isn't growing.

panels.title: Raw used in 30 days
panels.description: predict_linear over the last 7 days (or as much history as Prometheus has).

panels.title: Pools
panels.description: Stored = logical data, Raw = with replication. Forecast = stored in 30 days, linear over the last 7 days.

targets.expr: max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((ceph_pool_stored) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((ceph_pool_stored_raw) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((ceph_pool_percent_used) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((ceph_pool_max_avail) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((ceph_pool_objects) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((sum by (pool_id) (ceph_pg_total)) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((predict_linear(ceph_pool_stored[7d], 30 * 86400)) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)
max by (pool_id, name, application, description) ((rate(ceph_pool_rd[5m]) + rate(ceph_pool_wr[5m])) * on (pool_id) group_left (name, application, description) ceph_pool_metadata)

panels.title: Raw capacity and forecast
panels.description: The forecast line shows, at each point, where raw usage would be 30 days later at the growth rate of the 7 days before it.

panels.title: Client IOPS
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: Client op latency (OSD average)
panels.description: Sum of OSD op latency / ops over all OSDs, including queueing.

panels.title: IOPS per pool
panels.description: Writes below the axis.

panels.title: Throughput per pool
panels.description: Writes below the axis.

panels.title: PG states
panels.description: PGs per state (a PG is in several at once). Only non-zero states besides active and clean are listed: blue = routine (scrubbing, snap trimming), orange = recovering or degraded, red = needs attention.

panels.title: PGs not clean, by state
panels.description: Gaps mean zero.

panels.title: OSD flags
panels.description: Cluster-wide OSD flags (ceph osd set …). noout is normal during maintenance; anything left set stops recovery or scrubbing.

panels.title: OSD status
panels.description: One tile per OSD: green = up and in, blue = up but out, red = down but still in (data is degraded), purple = down and out. Click for the OSD dashboard.

panels.title: OSD hosts
panels.description: OSDs per PVE node.

targets.expr: sum by (hostname) ((ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata) / sum by (hostname) ((ceph_osd_stat_bytes) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)
sum by (hostname) ((rate(ceph_osd_op_r[5m]) + rate(ceph_osd_op_w[5m])) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)

panels.title: OSD details
panels.description: Latencies are averages over the last 5 minutes. Slow ops = ops over 10 s in the time range; BlueStore slow 24h = BlueStore operations over its slow-op threshold in the last 24 h (these raise BLUESTORE_SLOW_OP_ALERT). Click an OSD for its dashboard.

panels.title: OSD state history
panels.description: Flaps show up as red/blue slivers.

panels.title: Commit latency per OSD
panels.description: BlueStore commit latency as reported by each OSD (ceph osd perf).

panels.title: Utilization per OSD
panels.description: Uneven fill means uneven CRUSH weights or too few PGs; the balancer module evens it out.

panels.title: PGs per OSD
panels.description: mon_max_pg_per_osd defaults to 250.

targets.expr: ((sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_osd_op_r_latency_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_osd_op_r_latency_count[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata

((sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_osd_op_w_latency_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_osd_op_w_latency_count[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata

panels.title: IOPS per OSD
panels.description: Client ops each OSD served as primary.

panels.title: Throughput per OSD
panels.description: Client reads + writes per OSD.

panels.title: BlueStore slow-op alert
panels.description: Health check BLUESTORE_SLOW_OP_ALERT: OSDs logged more than bluestore_slow_ops_warn_threshold slow BlueStore ops within bluestore_slow_ops_warn_lifetime. Common on busy HDDs without a flash DB device.

panels.title: Daemons with slow ops now
panels.description: Daemons currently reporting blocked ops (SLOW_OPS health check).

panels.title: Slow ops in range
panels.description: Ops that took over 10 s, on any daemon, in the selected time range.

panels.title: BlueStore slow ops, last 24 h
panels.description: All four BlueStore slow-op counters, all OSDs, over the 24 h the health check looks back (bluestore_slow_ops_warn_lifetime). Needs 24 h of Prometheus history to be complete.

panels.title: Slow ops per daemon in range
panels.description: OSDs, monitors and the MDS (ops over 10 s).

panels.title: BlueStore slow ops per OSD, last 24 h
panels.description: Each column is one BlueStore slow-op counter: committed kv = slow RocksDB commits, aio wait = slow disk I/O, read onode meta / read wait aio = slow reads.

targets.expr: max by (ceph_daemon, hostname) ((increase(ceph_bluestore_slow_committed_kv_count[24h])) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname) ((increase(ceph_bluestore_slow_aio_wait_count[24h])) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname) ((increase(ceph_bluestore_slow_read_onode_meta_count[24h])) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname) ((increase(ceph_bluestore_slow_read_wait_aio_count[24h])) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata)

panels.title: Slow ops per daemon
panels.description: Slow ops counted per interval; bars only where there were any.

panels.title: BlueStore kv commit latency per OSD
panels.description: Time to commit a RocksDB batch. On HDD-only OSDs the DB shares the spindle, so this tracks disk load.

targets.expr: ((sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_bluestore_kv_commit_lat_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(ceph_bluestore_kv_commit_lat_count[$__rate_interval]))) >= 0) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_osd_metadata

panels.title: BlueStore latency breakdown (all OSDs)
panels.description: Average per operation over all OSDs.

panels.title: BlueStore free-space fragmentation
panels.description: Allocator fragmentation score per OSD (0 = contiguous free space, 1 = fully fragmented).

panels.title: RocksDB (BlueFS DB) used per OSD
panels.description: No separate DB/WAL devices: the DB lives on the OSD's HDD.

targets.expr: max by (ceph_daemon, hostname, rank) (ceph_mon_quorum_status * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname, rank) ceph_mon_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname, rank) (ceph_mon_num_sessions * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname, rank) ceph_mon_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname, rank) (increase(ceph_mon_num_elections[$__range]) * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname, rank) ceph_mon_metadata)
max by (ceph_daemon, hostname, rank) (ceph_daemon_health_metrics{type="SLOW_OPS"} * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname, rank) ceph_mon_metadata)

panels.title: Managers
panels.description: Only the active mgr serves metrics; Prometheus scrapes every mgr host so a failover needs no change.

targets.expr: max by (ceph_daemon, hostname) (ceph_mgr_status * on (ceph_daemon) group_left (hostname) ceph_mgr_metadata)

panels.title: Mgr modules
panels.description: Enabled mgr modules: blue = enabled by an admin, green = always on.

panels.title: Daemon versions
panels.description: More than one version per daemon type means an upgrade is in progress.

targets.expr: count by (type, version) (label_replace(label_replace(ceph_osd_metadata or ceph_mon_metadata or ceph_mgr_metadata or ceph_mds_metadata, "type", "$1", "ceph_daemon", "([a-z]+)\\..*"), "version", "$1 $2", "ceph_version", "ceph version (\\S+) \\(\\S+\\) (\\S+).*"))

panels.title: Paxos commit latency
panels.description: How long the monitors take to commit a map change.

panels.title: Mgr exporter targets
panels.description: Prometheus scrapes every mgr host; standbys answer with an empty page, so they're up but add no series.

panels.title: Filesystem
panels.description: CephFS filesystems.

panels.title: Active MDS
panels.description: MDS daemons holding a rank.

panels.title: Standby MDS
panels.description: Standby MDS daemons ready to take over a rank.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Client sessions on the active MDS (kernel/fuse mounts, PVE nodes).

panels.title: Caps
panels.description: Capabilities handed out to clients.

panels.title: Files
panels.description: Files in the filesystem (recursive count at /).

panels.title: Data
panels.description: Bytes in the filesystem (recursive size of /), before replication.

panels.title: RSS
panels.description: RSS of the active MDS (mds_cache_memory_limit caps the cache).

panels.title: Request latency by operation
panels.description: Average MDS service time per request type; idle types drop out.

panels.title: Journal and purge queue
panels.description: Strays are deleted files waiting for the purge queue.

panels.title: CephFS pools
panels.description: Data and metadata pool of each filesystem (one data pool each here).

targets.expr: (ceph_pool_stored) * on (pool_id) group_left (name) ceph_pool_metadata and on (pool_id) (label_replace(ceph_fs_metadata, "pool_id", "$1", "data_pools", "(.*)") or label_replace(ceph_fs_metadata, "pool_id", "$1", "metadata_pool", "(.*)"))

(ceph_pool_stored_raw) * on (pool_id) group_left (name) ceph_pool_metadata and on (pool_id) (label_replace(ceph_fs_metadata, "pool_id", "$1", "data_pools", "(.*)") or label_replace(ceph_fs_metadata, "pool_id", "$1", "metadata_pool", "(.*)"))

panels.title: RBD images (average over the time range)
panels.description: Images with any I/O in the selected time range (rbd_stats_pools = ceph_rbd). VM is the Proxmox VM id from the image name (vm-<id>-disk-N, base-<id>-… for templates).

targets.expr: max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range])) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace((rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace((rate(ceph_rbd_read_bytes[$__range])) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace((rate(ceph_rbd_write_bytes[$__range])) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace(((rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_sum[$__range]) / rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_count[$__range]) / 1e9) >= 0) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

max by (pool, image, vmid) (label_replace(((rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_sum[$__range]) / rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_count[$__range]) / 1e9) >= 0) and on (pool, namespace, image) ((rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops[$__range]) + rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops[$__range])) > 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*"))

panels.title: Top 10 images by write latency
panels.description: Latency seen by librbd (the VM), including the network and all replicas.

targets.expr: label_replace(topk(10, (sum by (pool, image) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pool, image) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_count[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9) >= 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*")

label_replace(topk(10, (sum by (pool, image) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pool, image) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_count[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9) >= 0), "vmid", "$1", "image", "(?:vm|base)-([0-9]+)-.*")

panels.title: PVE nodes
panels.description: OSD count per host from Ceph; CPU, memory, load and OSD disk busy % from node_exporter (job node, role proxmox), joined on the host label. Exporter shows DOWN when a node's node_exporter isn't scraped.

targets.expr: max by (host) (node_load5{job="node", role="proxmox"}) / count by (host) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job="node", role="proxmox"})

max by (host) (100 * avg by (host) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[5m]) and on (host, device) label_replace(label_replace(max by (ceph_daemon, instance, devices) (ceph_disk_occupation), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "device", "$1", "devices", "(.*)")))

panels.title: OSD disk utilization
panels.description: Share of time each OSD's disk was busy (node_exporter, joined via ceph_disk_occupation).

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (host, device) group_left (ceph_daemon) label_replace(label_replace(max by (ceph_daemon, instance, devices) (ceph_disk_occupation), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "device", "$1", "devices", "(.*)")

defaults.noValue: No data from node_exporter (job=node, role=proxmox) for this OSD's disk

panels.title: OSD disk await
panels.description: Average time per disk I/O as the kernel sees it.

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (host, device) group_left (ceph_daemon) label_replace(label_replace(max by (ceph_daemon, instance, devices) (ceph_disk_occupation), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "device", "$1", "devices", "(.*)")

(rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (host, device) group_left (ceph_daemon) label_replace(label_replace(max by (ceph_daemon, instance, devices) (ceph_disk_occupation), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "device", "$1", "devices", "(.*)")

defaults.noValue: No data from node_exporter (job=node, role=proxmox) for this OSD's disk
